binding_interpretation.DR-012: Move revealed/constrained cards into known zones and recompute route feasibility; revealed Prizes and inaccessible copies are not live outs; unknown cards remain probabilistic.
binding_interpretation.DR-017: Protect low-count or irreplaceable Energy, attacker, evolution, gust, recovery and search resources unless a forced terminal line or no alternative exists.
binding_interpretation.DR-021: Low opponent deck count is not a deck-out proof; draw obligation, recursion/recovery, horizon, self-deck and alternate Prize route must be checked.
binding_interpretation.DR-023: Unseen hand/deck/Prize identities stay probabilistic and never become a hard fact from absence or an action guess.
binding_interpretation.DR-024: Any probability formulation must allocate finite cards without replacement and must not manually control engine randomness.
binding_interpretation.DR-025: Current CABT legal options and version-bound native transition receipts outrank tabletop memory or static effect prose.
binding_interpretation.CON-001: Immediate Prize and robust route are not universally ordered; the ledger must expose the trade, not hide it in a blended score.
binding_interpretation.CON-002: Thinning is conditional on opportunity cost; B3 must not auto-thin.
binding_interpretation.RQ-004: Mega Abomasnow routes and first attacks remain unproven against held-out anchors.
binding_interpretation.RQ-005: Ledger/prize features still need an isolated held-out CABT ablation.
binding_interpretation.RQ-007: Every route-critical interaction needs an exact local capsule before runtime authority.

known_states: PUBLIC_USABLE: a visible card/entity whose current zone and serial/card_id are public and whose use is covered by a qualified receipt
PUBLIC_DISCARD_OR_RECOVERABLE: a visible discarded copy whose recovery path is itself qualified; it is not silently treated as usable
PUBLIC_INACCESSIBLE: a publicly identified Prize/deck/zone copy that the current route cannot use, with the identifying event or semantic receipt retained
unknown_states: UNKNOWN_OWN_DECK_OR_PRIZE: hidden candidate copies represented only as legal count intervals/compositions; never a named live/dead copy
UNKNOWN_OPPONENT: hidden opponent identities and response classes; no B3 formulation may turn them into facts
invariants: Each publicly identified physical copy is counted once, with a source observation/event digest and optional serial; known inaccessible copies are removed from live outs exactly once.
PlayerViewV1 deck/hand/Prize counts and ResourceLedgerSeedV1 hidden_slot_counts are capacities, not card identities or live-out counts.
A known reserve is computed only from PUBLIC_USABLE copies plus explicitly qualified recovery from PUBLIC_DISCARD_OR_RECOVERABLE; UNKNOWN states never increase a hard reserve.
A public reveal must be monotonic for the affected copy and must not be double-counted when it also appears in the current entity snapshot.

unknown_and_fail_closed_semantics.fail_closed_action: Return B0_DELEGATE to the frozen public control, with a distinct reason and counter. Do not call this final-adapter fallback, do not score a safe option prefix, and do not award B3 credit for a delegated decision.
unknown_and_fail_closed_semantics.no_hidden_identity_policy: The exact candidate deck list supplies total copy capacity only. A hidden own or opponent card remains an unknown/probability mass; no ledger row may name or count it as live, dead, prized, or held unless the current public contract explicitly reveals it.

formulations.name: Conservative known-copy reserve ledger
formulations.hypothesis: A lexicographic ledger that preserves hard-known route resources and refuses to spend an irreplaceable known copy will avoid losing-resource errors without relying on hidden card identities or uncertain opponent responses.
formulations.material_difference_from_B: A uses hard known-copy feasibility and a reserve floor; it does not use a draw probability or a hidden allocation probability to prefer an action.
observable_features: known own card copies by public zone and exact serial where available
known inaccessible/revealed copy count, separated from unknown cards
qualified current route requirements and visible attacker readiness
current action-local cost and exact qualified local delta
public bench capacity, public active/bench HP/status and qualified current threat only
decision_key: current terminal outcome is adapter/evaluator gate only and never a fabricated current action
preserve hard route feasibility after current local cost descending
preserve minimum known reserve for each still-required route resource descending
avoid spending a known unique/low-count resource needed by the shortest robust visible route
prefer already-qualified ready follow-up and lower known route deficit
prefer lower public deck-out/self-deck risk only when a complete receipt exists
canonical semantic action key only after the strategic key; non-equivalent ties are AMBIGUOUS
formulations.reserve_definition: For each route-critical class, reserve is the number of publicly known, legally usable copies/resources remaining after the current local cost minus the minimum number explicitly required by the qualified route. Unknown hidden copies are not added to reserve. A route fails the hard floor when a known required reserve becomes negative or a needed capability is unknown.
formulations.expected_behavior: Choose a current local attach/discard/search choice that leaves the required known Energy/attacker/search/recovery reserve intact; reject auto-thinning and any action whose only justification is an unseen card.
fail_closed: missing PrizeStaticV1 when Prize units enter the key
compound action outside the activation contract

formulations.name: Conditional draw-probability and resource-preservation ordering
formulations.hypothesis: When hard known reserves do not distinguish choices, an exact finite-deck without-replacement calculation over public counts can prefer the action that gives the route a higher conditional probability of obtaining the required own-deck outs, while explicitly pricing consumed search/attach/recovery resources.
formulations.material_difference_from_A: B may choose a replaceable resource-spend or lower hard reserve when its public finite-deck conditional route probability is higher; A never treats a hidden card as a live copy and never uses probability as a hard reserve substitute.
observable_features: candidate profile total counts and public known copies by zone
public deck/Prize/hand counts and revealed/inaccessible copies as constraints
without-replacement finite-deck probability for named own-deck outs over a predeclared draw horizon
conditional probability after a named current resource cost/search effect only if its local receipt is exact
opportunity cost: consumed search, gust, recovery, Energy, bench slot or evolution resource
formulations.probability_rule: Enumerate count states, not card identities or deck order. Condition only on public observations and exact candidate multiset counts; use hypergeometric or exact finite-state counting without independent-draw shortcuts. If an unknown Prize/deck allocation is relevant, marginalize legal allocations or return UNKNOWN; never select one hidden allocation as fact.

inputs: candidate DeckProfileV1 multiset and its version-bound card-table/deck hashes
current PublicStateV1 visible_card_counts, visible_zone_counts, hidden_slot_counts, PlayerViewV1 counts and current request
a named route requirement and exact current local delta from an independently reviewed receipt
probability_model_provenance_and_math.simple_hit_formula: For a fixed publicly determined deck composition of N unknown draw slots containing K eligible outs, a h-step without-replacement hit probability is 1 - C(N-K,h)/C(N,h), with h bounded by the predeclared horizon and 0 <= h <= N.
probability_model_provenance_and_math.multi_role_formula: For multiple role/count requirements, enumerate nonnegative draw-count vectors over the candidate multiset and sum exact multivariate-hypergeometric weights for vectors satisfying the predeclared route predicate; use integer/rational arithmetic (for example Fraction), not independent Bernoulli products or floating-point ranking keys.
probability_model_provenance_and_math.hidden_allocation_rule: If an unknown own deck/Prize allocation changes K, the route predicate, or the ordering between actions, return UNKNOWN unless a separately approved, versioned allocation measure is supplied. Do not silently assume uniform allocations, a guessed Prize map, or an engine RNG law.
probability_model_provenance_and_math.action_conditioning_rule: A current action may alter the count model only through an exact receipt for its local cost/search/recovery transition. A future draw or route horizon is a count calculation, not a successor observation; no native successor call or counterfactual terminal result is permitted.
probability_model_provenance_and_math.validation: Reject negative/nonintegral counts, h>N, empty denominators, NaN/Inf, probabilities outside [0,1], and any result whose ordering changes under legal hidden allocations. Retain numerator/denominator or exact count-state digest for independent recomputation.

decision_key: hard known route-feasibility floor: any action below an explicit nonnegative reserve floor delegates
higher conditional probability of satisfying the predeclared route requirement within the predeclared horizon
lower consumed resource opportunity cost under the same public route
lower deck-out risk only with complete deck-out receipt; no low-count shortcut
canonical semantic action key only after the strategic key; non-equivalent ties are AMBIGUOUS
formulations.expected_behavior: On a divergence fixture, prefer the action with greater exact public finite-deck route probability when both choices retain the hard feasibility floor, even if B3-A prefers the larger known reserve. It must not become a generic 'draw more' or automatic thinning rule.
probability_limits: no hidden opponent list or response prior
no effect probability unless a CABT receipt supplies the effect transition
no probability claim if conditioning fields are incomplete
fail_closed: ambiguous hidden allocation that changes ordering

deterministic_fixture_contract.purpose: Falsify the two ledger formulations before native integration. Fixtures are sealed public records and local-delta descriptions only; they are not native game evidence or successor inputs to PolicyV1.
fixture_requirements: Use actual EngineObservationV1/SelectionRequestV1-compatible public fields and canonical semantic fingerprints, or an explicitly separate ledger fixture schema that cannot be imported by runtime PolicyV1.
Bind every resource/Prize unit field to a named receipt status; FIXTURE_ONLY never activates native authority.
Represent unknown own/opponent hidden allocations as intervals/count states, never as chosen card identities.
Use exact integer counts, rational probabilities or decimal values with declared precision; reject NaN/Inf/negative counts.
Present the complete option set, including all available alternatives; do not create a safe prefix or omit a control option.
Run each fixture through both formulations with semantic option permutations and both player perspectives.

B3-F01-RESERVE-ODDS-DIVERGENCE: Two and only two non-equivalent legal singleton options with distinct canonical semantic fingerprints and a complete option-set digest.
Public count-state tables before each option and declared exact local deltas after each option; no successor observation.

For A: explicit reserve vectors and floor values that make the selected option unique. For B: integer N/K/h or a finite count-state table plus exact Fraction numerator/denominator for each option, with a declared route predicate and opportunity-cost vector.
The fixture must show A and B selecting different options while both satisfy the hard reserve floor; if the values do not diverge, the fixture is INCONCLUSIVE rather than a formulation proof.
B3-F02-REVEALED-PRIZE-REMOVAL: A public reveal/event receipt identifying exactly one physical copy, its before/after ledger category, and a digest proving no double count.
B3-F03-IRREPLACEABLE-DISCARD: Exact card-role counts, recoverability receipt status, complete discard option set, and a declared forced-terminal/no-alternative flag.
B3-F04-DECKOUT-NOT-LOW-COUNT: Public deck count plus explicit missing draw obligation, recursion/recovery, horizon, self-deck, or alternate-Prize proof fields; omitted proof must produce B0_DELEGATE.
B3-F05-COMPLETE-OPTIONS-AND-STOP: Separate request records for mandatory singleton, optional singleton with a legal STOP token, ORDERED multi-select, and UNORDERED multi-select; each records min/max, complete available mask, and expected delegation/STOP trace.
B3-F06-LIFECYCLE-PLAYER-MIRROR: Fresh-process records for start, terminal, error, worker replacement, duplicate/stale request, and mirrored player histories keyed by (episode_uuid, player_index, policy_id).

named_fixtures.purpose: A and B must disagree for a real reason rather than being aliases.
named_fixtures.public_state: Visible own route resources and exact public counts expose two legal singleton options: one preserves the larger hard known reserve; the other consumes a replaceable search resource but has the higher exact finite-deck probability of meeting a predeclared own-deck route requirement within a fixed horizon. Opponent hidden cards are absent.
named_fixtures.expected: A selects the higher hard-reserve option. B selects the higher conditional-probability option only when the hard reserve floor remains nonnegative. If the allocation or effect receipt is incomplete, both delegate.
named_fixtures.anti_shortcut: No raw option order, giant weighted score, hidden card identity or auto-thinning rationale can reproduce the expected label.

named_fixtures.purpose: Verify that a publicly revealed/prized route-critical copy is removed from live outs.
named_fixtures.public_state: The same public board is shown twice; the second fixture adds a semantically identified inaccessible/revealed copy and keeps all other counts equal.
named_fixtures.expected: Both formulations reduce live known-out/reserve or probability as required by the receipt. Neither treats an unrevealed Prize slot as a named copy.

named_fixtures.purpose: Guard DR-017 and reject generic hand-size optimization.
named_fixtures.public_state: Complete current discard options contain a known unique route resource and a known replaceable/dead card, with no forced terminal line.
named_fixtures.expected: A preserves the unique resource. B may differ only if its declared conditional route probability and hard reserve contract prove the difference; otherwise it preserves the resource.

named_fixtures.public_state: Opponent public deck count is low, but draw obligation, recursion/recovery or faster Prize route is unknown.
named_fixtures.expected: Neither formulation selects deck-out as an objective or assigns a favorable terminal value; both delegate if a decision requires an unqualified alternate-win effect.

named_fixtures.purpose: Verify that optional singleton and compound semantics are not silently bypassed.
named_fixtures.public_state: Include optional min_count=0/max_count=1, mandatory singleton, unordered multi-select, ordered multi-select and legal STOP cases with semantically permuted option transport order.
named_fixtures.expected: Only covered singleton/explicit STOP requests may activate. Unsupported count/order or unresolved STOP delegates B0; no fixture may produce a final action with an invalid count or duplicate index.

named_fixtures.purpose: Verify public state reset and player symmetry.
named_fixtures.public_state: Replay identical public records across new episode/player/policy tuples, including terminal/error/worker replacement boundaries and player-1 mirror.
named_fixtures.expected: Identical public histories yield identical ledger digests; no prior episode/seat state leaks; all counters are isolated by (episode_uuid, player, policy_id).

deterministic_fixture_contract.fixture_verdict: A positive fixture result is a qualification of the evaluator boundary only. It cannot establish route strength, native effect semantics, or production authority.

runtime_guard.probability_authority: B3-B may rank by an exact public count-state probability only when the conditioning counts, route predicate, horizon, local-delta receipt and allocation measure are version-bound and the ordering is invariant over any unmeasured legal allocation; otherwise it delegates B0. No uniform hidden-allocation prior or engine-randomness assumption is implicit.
runtime_guard.request_identity: monotonic selection_seq plus request_id and content digests; duplicate identical requests may be idempotent, changed/stale/out-of-order requests reject
runtime_guard.semantic_order: canonical semantic fingerprint only; raw option order and original_index are never strategy features
runtime_guard.runtime_complexity: bounded current-state count arithmetic; no search, particles, network, GPU or successor engine calls

safety_limits.latency_metrics: candidate-only p50/p95/p99 and max with request-cardinality equality

comparison_and_promotion_contract.control: frozen public deterministic B0 Mega Abomasnow control using the exact same deck, engine, card data, wrapper, public observation contract and native anchors
equal_budget_definition: same per-arm game count, four native anchors, natural deployment and candidate seat balance
same request cap, game timeout, wall timeout, worker topology, evidence cap and conservative CPU/RSS limits

same exact deck/card/engine/wrapper/source receipt requirements and fresh-process resume checks

arm_execution.mode: two independent B0-compatible two-arm runs, one for B3-A versus a fresh B0 control and one for B3-B versus a fresh B0 control
arm_execution.control_reuse: Do not reuse one B0 game sample across formulations or treat the two candidate arms as paired. Each run has its own sealed control manifest and independent native randomness.
arm_execution.reason: The current B0 harness is a two-arm candidate/control contract; a future three-arm harness would require a separately reviewed execution and dependence plan rather than silently reusing controls.

analysis.outcome: terminal WDL only; Prize margin and route diagnostics are secondary
analysis.uncertainty: independent anchor/seat-stratified bootstrap with 10,000 resamples and 95 percent intervals, plus Wilson intervals per arm
analysis.estimand: Report every one of the eight anchor x candidate-seat cells. The primary candidate-minus-control comparison is the equal fixed-weight mean of the eight independently resampled cell deltas; pooled all-game WDL is descriptive only and cannot replace the cell estimand.
analysis.report: all-anchor equal-cell aggregate, pooled descriptive aggregate, and every anchor/seat cell; forced actual-first/second diagnostics are separate
analysis.strength_credit: Report all games and the nondelegated subset, but the primary effectiveness estimand uses all completed games and treats delegation as behavior, not a hidden oracle. Activation/delegation is never blended into WDL.
analysis.activation_gate: A confirmation arm is INCONCLUSIVE/no-op unless it has at least 32 nondelegated B3 decisions and at least 5 percent of eligible current requests active; the local screen uses the same preregistered denominator rule with an 8-decision minimum.

verdicts.PROMOTE: Only qualifies an experimental B3 challenger after independent raw-manifest review, zero reliability counters, no budget/provenance/semantic violations, at least the activation gate, no anchor/seat catastrophic regression, a confirmation equal-cell lower 95 percent interval for B3 minus B0 strictly above +0.02, and an observed equal-cell point estimate at least B0. It is not a deck freeze, champion, gold/medal, or submission authorization.
verdicts.REJECT_FOR_RELIABILITY: Any hard reliability, legality, provenance, hidden-information, manual-randomness or runtime-budget defect; strength result is invalid regardless of WDL.
verdicts.REJECT_FORMULATION: After the confirmation budget and clean reliability review, the upper 95 percent interval for B3 minus B0 is at or below zero, or a predeclared target-cell criterion fails without a justified new hypothesis, or any anchor/seat cell is more than 0.10 below B0 or has a hard catastrophic failure.
verdicts.NO_PROMOTION_INCONCLUSIVE: A clean result whose equal-cell lower interval is above zero but at or below +0.02, whose interval crosses zero, or whose active denominator is below the activation gate remains an unresolved challenger; do not tune after seeing outcomes.
verdicts.NO_OPPORTUNITY: If B3 has fewer than 32 active decisions or less than 5 percent activation at confirmation, report zero effective activation and no strength claim; this is not evidence that the ledger concept is false.

comparison_and_promotion_contract.promotion_scope: A promoted B3 arm would still be bound to the exact Mega Abomasnow deck and receipt versions. It would not authorize a different deck, route, opponent belief, search branch or submission.
